title: party.change
description: FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.3, Q17: an effect the hidden game had on a Pokémon outside items (overworld poison, a haircut, a massage); Cobblemon sets the value and the next sync brings the result.

id.description: Idempotent: Cobblemon applies an id once.

hp.description: The HP the hidden record has now (it mirrors Cobblemon's max HP).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
